_note: Platform settings catalogue (spec 6.3, FR-7 to FR-14a): labels, groups, ranges and help for each setting. The settings panel, the tooltips and the compare view are built from this file.

fields.label: Wi-Fi generation
fields.help: The Wi-Fi standard generation of the simulated device, from 802.11b to Wi-Fi 7.
fields.effect: Limits the bands, bandwidths and features, and changes frame lengths: older generations send longer frames.

fields.label: Wi-Fi band
fields.help: The band Wi-Fi uses: 2.4, 5 or 6 GHz.
fields.effect: Only 2.4 GHz overlaps Bluetooth in frequency; 5 and 6 GHz interact only through the platform.

fields.label: Wi-Fi channel
fields.help: The Wi-Fi channel number. On 2.4 GHz the centre frequency is 2407 plus 5 times the channel number.
fields.effect: Moves the orange band in the frequency view and changes which Bluetooth hops are hit.

fields.label: Wi-Fi bandwidth
fields.help: The channel width in MHz.
fields.effect: A wider channel covers more of the Bluetooth band and shortens frames.

fields.label: Bluetooth Core version of the device
fields.help: The highest Bluetooth Core Specification version the simulated device supports.
fields.effect: Tasks and parameters that need a later version are greyed out and flagged.

fields.label: Front-end arrangement
fields.help: How Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connect to antennas: a shared antenna with a switch, separate antennas, or a shared antenna with a diplexer or combiner.
fields.effect: A shared antenna forces taking turns. Separate antennas let both run, depending on isolation.

choiceLabels.SHARED_DIPLEXER: Shared antenna with a diplexer or combiner

fields.label: Isolation between Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
fields.help: How much a transmitter on one side is attenuated at the other side's receiver, in dB.
fields.effect: Above the interaction threshold an overlap is tolerated; below it a receive may be corrupted.

fields.label: Interaction threshold
fields.help: The isolation below which separate paths still interact.
fields.effect: Moves the line between tolerated and degraded overlaps.

fields.label: Guard around the Wi-Fi channel
fields.help: Extra margin on each side of the Wi-Fi channel that counts as overlap for Bluetooth, standing in for spectral skirts.
fields.effect: Widens the footprint in the frequency view and in adaptive hopping.

fields.label: Number of cores
fields.help: How many radio cores serve Wi-Fi and Bluetooth: one combo core, or separate cores.
fields.effect: One core can only serve one radio at a time unless the hardware allows concurrent operation.

fields.label: Core behaviour
fields.help: How the cores work together: time-division arbitration, concurrent operation where hardware allows, or priority-based pre-emption.
fields.effect: Concurrent operation lets overlapping blocks run together; the other modes make them take turns.

fields.label: Wi-Fi streams (TX x RX)
fields.help: Number of Wi-Fi spatial streams, for example 1x1 or 2x2.
fields.effect: More streams raise the rate and shorten frames.

fields.label: Wi-Fi chains in the device
fields.help: How many Wi-Fi radio chains the device has. Streams cannot exceed this.
fields.effect: Caps the stream count.

fields.label: Simultaneous Wi-Fi TX with Bluetooth RX
fields.help: Whether the platform can transmit Wi-Fi while receiving Bluetooth.
fields.effect: If off, that pair always takes turns, even with separate antennas.

fields.label: Wi-Fi multi-role
fields.help: Whether the device can be an access point and a station together.
fields.effect: Allows soft-AP and station tasks in one scenario.

fields.label: Multi-link simultaneous TX and RX
fields.help: Whether Wi-Fi 7 multi-link operation can send on one link while receiving on another.
fields.effect: Affects how the links of a multi-link task interact.

fields.label: Arbitration policy
fields.help: Who wins when Bluetooth and Wi-Fi want the air together: by priority, first come first served, Bluetooth favoured, Wi-Fi favoured, or time share.
fields.effect: Changes which block is granted, delayed or lost.

fields.label: Time share: Bluetooth share
fields.help: Share of the time slices given to Bluetooth when the policy is time share.
fields.effect: Moves the split between the two technologies.

fields.label: Time share: slice length
fields.help: Length of each time slice when the policy is time share.
fields.effect: Shorter slices alternate more often.

fields.label: Adaptive frequency hopping
fields.help: Bluetooth removes channels inside the Wi-Fi channel from its hop set, after a delay.
fields.effect: Hops stop landing inside the Wi-Fi channel once the map takes effect.
fields.typical: On when Wi-Fi shares the band

fields.label: AFH minimum channels (Classic)
fields.help: The fewest Classic channels the hop set may keep.
fields.effect: A higher minimum keeps some channels inside the Wi-Fi channel.

fields.label: AFH minimum channels (LE)
fields.help: The fewest LE data channels the hop set may keep.
fields.effect: A higher minimum keeps some channels inside the Wi-Fi channel.

fields.label: AFH delay
fields.help: How long before the new channel map takes effect.
fields.effect: Conflicts are still shown in the first part of the window.

fields.label: Retry limit
fields.help: The most retries a block gets before it is counted as lost.
fields.effect: Stops endless retry loops.

fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Seed for the repeatable random numbers (hops, delays, backoff).
fields.effect: The same seed and settings always give the same result.

fields.label: Simulation window
fields.help: Length of time simulated, in microseconds.
fields.effect: Longer windows show more events and take longer to draw.

fields.label: Limit: BLE connections
fields.help: The most simultaneous LE connections the device supports.
fields.effect: Selecting more raises a validation error.

fields.label: Limit: eSCO links
fields.help: The most eSCO voice links the device supports at once.
fields.effect: Selecting more raises a validation error.

fields.label: Limit: isochronous streams
fields.help: The most concurrent LE Audio streams the device supports.
fields.effect: Selecting more raises a validation error.
